description: This file contains the implementation of the Stream class in the nyholm/psr7 library, which provides a concrete implementation of the PSR-7 StreamInterface for handling HTTP message streams using PHP resources.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Provides a PSR-7 Stream implementation wrapping a PHP resource, supporting stream operations such as read, write, seek, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the stream object with a resource, setting up its seekable, readable, and writable states based on stream metadata.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Stream object from a string, resource, or existing StreamInterface.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the resource from the Stream, making it unusable.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Retrieves the URI metadata of the stream if available.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream content, if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the file pointer.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached end-of-file.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Determines if the stream can seek.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the pointer to a specific position within the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the remaining contents of the stream as a string.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stream metadata or a specific key.
